detaileddescription.para: RocksDB baseline: Sequential writes Expected: ~1M writes/sec on SSD (per RocksDB documentation) Actual: Measure to identify gap
Random access performance Expected: 10-50% of sequential throughput Actual: Measure to identify gap
Transaction overhead Expected: <5% overhead vs non-transactional Actual: Measure overhead
Index creation overhead Expected: O(1) for empty index, O(n*log(n)) for populated Actual: Measure to identify gaps
Concurrent operations efficiency Expected: Near-linear scaling up to CPU cores (then sublinear) Actual: Measure to identify bottlenecks

briefdescription.para: Advanced benchmark patterns following OOP and best-practices.

detaileddescription.para:
Tests:
Read/Write ratio combinations (20R/80W, 50R/50W, 80R/20W, 100R, 100W)
Parallel scalability (1, 4, 8, 16, 32 threads)
Self-protection mechanisms (burst load, sustained load, concurrent connections)
Best-practice patterns vs anti-patterns
Gap analysis against documented capabilities and internet standards
Build: cmake build . target bench_advanced_patterns config Release Run: ./bench_advanced_patterns.exe
